ruleDefinitions.name: Password Protected ZIP File Opened
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the extraction of password protected ZIP archives. See the filename variable for more details on which file has been opened. Note: Unmapped fields: TargetName

sequences.query: (event_id = 5379 AND TargetName = RGX(".*Microsoft\\_Windows\\_Shell\\_ZipFolder\\:filename.*")) AND  NOT (TargetName = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet\\ Files\\\\Content\\\.Outlook.*"))
